ssh_bruteforce.name: SSH Brute-Force Attempt
ssh_bruteforce.description: Multiple failed SSH authentication attempts from a single source IP within a short time window.

ssh_invalid_user_spray.name: SSH Invalid Username Enumeration
ssh_invalid_user_spray.description: Repeated SSH login attempts targeting non-existent usernames (user spraying / dictionary attack).

ssh_root_login_attempt.name: Direct Root SSH Login Attempt
ssh_root_login_attempt.description: Authentication attempt targeting the privileged root account over SSH.

web_sqli_probe.name: SQL Injection (SQLi) Probe Detected
web_sqli_probe.description: HTTP request URI or query string contains SQL injection payload signatures.

web_xss_probe.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Probe Detected
web_xss_probe.description: HTTP request contains reflected or DOM-based XSS payload patterns.
web_xss_probe.mitre_technique: T1059.007 - Command and Scripting Interpreter: JavaScript

web_path_traversal.name: Path Traversal / LFI Attempt
web_path_traversal.description: Request attempts directory traversal or local file inclusion targeting sensitive OS files.

web_sensitive_file_scan.name: Sensitive File & Config Exposure Scan
web_sensitive_file_scan.description: Automated probe targeting hidden configuration, backup, or source control files.

web_dir_bruteforce.name: High-Rate 404 Directory Enumeration
web_dir_bruteforce.description: Rapid burst of HTTP 404 responses indicating automated scanner activity (e.g., Gobuster/Dirsearch).

web_scanner_ua.name: Known Offensive Scanner User-Agent
web_scanner_ua.description: HTTP request originated from a known automated security scanner User-Agent string.
